# МинДеп.рейтинг — казино с минимальным депозитом (RU) / MinDep.rating (EN)

> Static comparison site: 10 casinos ranked by SBP withdrawal speed, wagering transparency and licence. Data lives in one JSON file; all pages are generated from it. 18+.

## Pages (RU)
- [Рейтинг ТОП-12](https://minimalniy-deposit.github.io/): full review, FAQ, guides
- [Методы пополнения](https://minimalniy-deposit.github.io/methods/): casino × payment-method table
- [Методология](https://minimalniy-deposit.github.io/methodology/): selection criteria and data sources
